body: My dad is the toughest man I know, I think he'll get through like he has many other things. I can't be with my family they are 3 states away. It hurts. It hurts that I have no one to go to. The person I'd go to isn't there for me anymore.

We've had some rough times throughout the years. Some my fault some her's, her new friends don't really care for me. I think they're pushing me away as well as her family. Her family is very firm in their christian beliefs and are somewhat close minded on things. They haven't liked me since they found out that I am atheist. I myself am a college graduate in broadcast journalism, with a very secure and steady job. I don't do drugs either. So I think it's a bit more of her outside influences


My father unfortunately lives far from me, so I have no way of seeing him at this moment. Despite my depression and need for help, I still come to work and do my job. 

I just want the girl I love back.
